assertions.name: Devices match legacy identities and timestamps
assertions.query: WITH expected AS (SELECT r.device_id, r.zone_id, r.source, d.first_seen, r.recorded_at AS last_seen FROM baseline.readings r JOIN (SELECT device_id, MIN(recorded_at) AS first_seen, MAX(id) AS latest FROM baseline.readings GROUP BY device_id) d ON r.id = d.latest), missing AS (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT device_id, zone_id, source, first_seen, last_seen FROM main.devices), extra AS (SELECT device_id, zone_id, source, first_seen, last_seen FROM main.devices EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM missing) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM extra)

assertions.name: Legacy thresholds copied to both modes
assertions.query: WITH expected AS (SELECT zone_id, 'device' AS source, moisture_min FROM baseline.thresholds UNION ALL SELECT zone_id, 'simulator', moisture_min FROM baseline.thresholds), missing AS (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT zone_id, source, moisture_min FROM main.thresholds) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM missing
